notes.bukhari:1510: Both complete fields supply Abu Said's practice during the Prophet's time on Eid al-Fitr and his separate description of the food then used. Retain the parenthetic food-grain object of the one-sa payment and the those-days temporal qualifier of the following list; both materially define the reported practice. Preserve barley, zabib, paneer and dates exactly. The initial multistep chain remains context; the actual recollection and food description stay under Abu Said's own voice, not direct Prophetic speech.
notes.bukhari:1511: Both full fields contain a Prophetic payment report, a later people's wheat-equivalence determination and distinct later practices of Ibn Umar, followed by two explicit Bukhari explanations. Preserve the printed fitr-or-Ramadan wording uncertainty without choosing one as certain, all four participant categories and the all-parenthesis, one-sa alternatives, half-sa later determination, date practice, Medina shortage/barley substitution, small/large scope, my-sons wording, every-poor-person-who-accepts restriction, and one-or-two-days-prior practice. The later practice narration changes voice from the Prophetic instruction; retain the unqualified my pronoun as supplied and describe the compiler's separate Nafi identification in context rather than inserting a missing narrative link. Both named compiler explanations, including the collecting-versus-poor-recipient discussion, remain source context; do not use them to rewrite the earlier actual wording. The prefatory route is context. Different actual voices require ordered components and explicit qualification, not one continuous Prophetic quotation.
notes.bukhari:1512: Both complete own fields supply Ibn Umar's report of one sa of barley or dates for small, large, free and enslaved persons. Keep that own order, amount, alternatives and categories, without filling male/female or Muslim qualifications from another occurrence. Preserve the final reporter's coherent attribution and actual report while moving the earlier multistep route to context.
notes.bukhari:1513: Both complete fields supply Fadl riding behind at the farewell pilgrimage, the source-described Khatham woman, mutual looking, the Prophet's source-rendered repeated intention to turn the face, her elderly father's obligation and inability to sit on the camel, the on-his-behalf question and yes answer. Preserve the source's actual intention wording rather than strengthening it to a completed action. Keep the farewell-pilgrimage temporal frame and final occurrence statement. The parenthetic badal term only labels an already explicit on-his-behalf relationship and stays lexical context; the relationship and incapacity remain selected. Keep all names and limits without a modern ruling or external identity. The prefatory route is context.
notes.bukhari:1515: Both complete own fields supply the actual Dhul-Hulayfa ihram event when the mount stood upright carrying the Prophet. Preserve the location and temporal circumstance under Jabir's reported attribution. The prefatory route and final notice that the report also comes through Ibn Abbas and Anas are transmission apparatus, not extra body; do not construct those parallel versions.
